gen-gf-revalia-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Revalia swaggers in with a low-contrast, widely spaced display look and a g that leaves its lower curve open. Alumni Sans Pinstripe tucks in beneath, tight and sans-serif, with oversized lowercase.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Squeezed together and tall in the lowercase, Alumni Sans SC reads compact and contemporary. Revalia, by contrast, strides along with widely separated letters, and that loosened pace is what makes the two memorable.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-anaheim: Anaheim packs its rounded, sans-serif letters into a dense huddle that the eye slides through easily. And Revalia's wide-striding display shapes give that tight texture something bold and loose to push against.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-arsenal: Arsenal reads close-knit, with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Revalia is the loud one here, a display face with almost no stroke variation, while Arsenal's sans-serif strokes swell and thin just slightly, a gentle shift that makes the pairing feel lived-in.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC fits its characters tightly, with a faint thick-thin shift and generous openings in its rounds. Yet Revalia spreads out above it with wide, bold display letters, so the page alternates between loose and snug.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-asimovian: Tall and uniform, with stroke ends that look cut from one ribbon, Asimovian is a sans-serif that stays out of the way. Revalia's wide, bold letters feel like a louder cousin beside it.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-basic: Revalia comes in bold and expressive, a display face whose letters stand well apart from each other. Basic follows in sans-serif, with a gentle bump from small letters up to capitals that keeps the tone friendly.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-cal-sans: Cal Sans reads modern and approachable, with one stroke width throughout and a tall x-height. Revalia sets the heading in a bolder, widely spaced display voice, while Cal Sans holds the text with short ascenders and no heavy-to-light shifts.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-carlito: Revalia's open-bottomed g and relaxed, widely separated letters give it a loose, bold display swagger. Carlito does the quieter work, a sans-serif with open rounds that stay legible small and tight spacing like thread on a spool.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-changa: Changa has a lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals. Revalia adds a wide, bold display stride above it, and that sturdy sans against loose display letters is the pair's strongest quality.
